content.text: {"narrative":[{"claim":"UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $9.326 billion in 2022, a figure flagged as one to watch.","cites":["kpi:256"]},{"claim":"UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $8.920 billion in 2023 and $8.263 billion in 2024.","cites":["kpi:257","kpi:250"]},{"claim":"UNICEF's Core Resources income in 2024 was $1.584 billion, which was 46% of total income.","cites":["kpi:245","kpi:251"]},{"claim":"Core Resources income in 2024 included $724.9 million from the private sector and $512.6 million from the public sector.","cites":["kpi:247","kpi:246"]},{"claim":"In 2024 UNICEF's Other Resources Regular made up 49% of total income, while Other Resources Emergency made up 5%.","cites":["kpi:252","kpi:253"]},{"claim":"In India in 2024, safely managed water supplies were provided to 59.3 million people and sanitation services to 17.9 million people.","cites":["kpi:266","kpi:267"]}]}
